newsitem.title: FRANCE: French policeman served 13 years with phony papers.
newsitem.headline: French policeman served 13 years with phony papers.

text.p: A French police union called on Wednesday for an investigation after an illegal Senegalese immigrant managed to serve as a police officer for 13 years with fake identity papers.
A man identified only as "Malik Etienne C." had "been able to dupe the police for nearly 13 years", the CUP union said in a statement.

Malik Etienne C. entered the French police force in 1984 after completing his studies, borrowing the identity papers of a friend who had won French citizenship to prove he qualified for the job. He had previously served in the French army.
Malik Etienne C. worked uneventfully as a traffic officer until last month when police arrested three Senegalese immigrants who told them of his ruse.
He was arrested on July 26 and is in custody.
